clv_true_closes_price_only.basis: price-only: close mid of the held side minus the price paid; canonical published closes only (no capture proxy)

game_axis.roi_single_vs_multi_note: split by games, game-clustered; a lead only

ladder.filters: CLOSE_OK, two-sided, width <= 10c, close mid in [0.02, 0.98], outcome derivable from final scores

data.provenance: All fills are owner fills. No thesis, model probability, recommendation id or usage projection is recorded with any of them.

ladder_market_wide.moneyline_note: moneyline rungs come in complementary pairs (the two teams' mids sum to 1), so mean(outcome - mid) is zero by construction; excluded
ladder_market_wide.scope: every published-close rung of every game with published closes, not only what the owner traded; taker ask, approximate fee

redaction: counts, ratios, z-scores and intervals only; no ticker, order id, game code, player or dollar figure

all_full_game_markets.reading: owner = structure + selection. Structure is what a buyer of the same series/side/price band earned at the closes (includes crossing the book, excludes fees). Selection is what is left to the owner's choice of game and rung.

spread.reading: owner = structure + selection. Structure is what a buyer of the same series/side/price band earned at the closes (includes crossing the book, excludes fees). Selection is what is left to the owner's choice of game and rung.

team_total.reading: owner = structure + selection. Structure is what a buyer of the same series/side/price band earned at the closes (includes crossing the book, excludes fees). Selection is what is left to the owner's choice of game and rung.

edge_vs_realised_excess.note: claimed edge is the shadow model's; realised excess is outcome minus price paid (before fees)

shadow_model_join.label: LEAD
shadow_model_join.provenance: SHADOW model probabilities (point-in-time, latest observation at or before the first fill). NOT the owner's probabilities: the owner's wagers carry no recorded model number, thesis or recommendation id.

owner_vs_sportsbook_closing_line.basis: sportsbook consensus CLOSING line (nflverse spread_line), not a Kalshi price and not point-in-time at the fill
